description:
Marine Le Pen promet de maintenir l'aide à l'Ukraine six mois si elle est élue ⏳🐱 Pour 🐱 ou contre ❌ ? Un émoji suffit 👇
#actu #politique #ukraine #marinelepen #presidentielle2027

segments.text: Six mois, pas un de plus.
segments.bg: a sunny paved square in front of a modern glass building with blue flags, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: placing a giant hourglass on a pedestal, pushing it gently to start the sand running
segments.accessory: a navy blue scarf and small work gloves

segments.text: Si elle est élue, l'aide à l'Ukraine durerait six mois.
segments.bg: a wide warehouse loading dock with wooden crates stacked high and a blue and yellow ribbon, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: rolling a crate toward a truck while looking back over its shoulder

segments.text: Ensuite, elle la couperait : plus les moyens, dit-elle.
segments.bg: a dusty old warehouse with empty wooden shelves and a single bare lightbulb, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: shaking an empty wallet upside down while a few coins drop out

segments.text: Pour certains, la facture irait vers l'Europe.
segments.bg: a wide avenue in Brussels with European flags and a tall glass building, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: dragging a heavy suitcase toward a tall pile of other suitcases marked with blue stars
segments.accessory: a tiny blue and gold tie

segments.text: Gaspard, lui, arrête ses croquettes après six minutes.
segments.bg: a cozy kitchen with a wooden table and a bowl of kibble, warm light, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: stopping in front of an empty kibble bowl with a dramatic sigh, paws on its hips

segments.text: Tu y crois ? Mets un chat. Contre ? Mets une croix.
segments.bg: a stage with a warm spotlight and a red velvet curtain, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: standing on the stage with both paws open, looking straight at the camera as if asking a question
